svg.text: Baseline and precision: establish what may change
Is the original correct and able to fit? How much quality is lost by reducing bit widths?
Solid: baseline, retry, integration. Dashed: references, controls, verification, reproduction.
Green: stage evidence passed; red: over budget/failed; amber: timing pending; dashed border: plan; gray: external parent.
